peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when DESIGN.md does not settle it.

commands: ls -la; rg --files | head -100; rg -n "charge\(|retry|queue|client" DESIGN.md src/payments.ts
turns.final: Plan submitted: retries belong in the queue; keep `charge()` as a single attempt and cover retry behavior with queue-level tests.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Add retry handling in the queue layer that invokes charge(), not inside charge() or HttpClient, so the shared client/batch path remains non-retrying. Keep charge() as a single POST with its existing 5xx error behavior. Add queue-level tests for transient failures followed by success, retry exhaustion, and non-retryable responses; preserve the existing HttpClient stubbing assumptions and avoid overriding BASE."}
